scope: Full-cone upper proof completion for both unresolved fixed-witness leaves, same frozen Port10 problem. No native Result admission.
proof: The leaf's optimizer term is an upper bound on eta iff some direction has all six scores <= that term. It suffices to use the six listed optimizer candidates. Complement of their union is the intersection over witnesses of unions of strict inequalities F_v>term. Recursively choose one strict violating raw term per candidate, intersect exact closed polygon halfspaces and check all strict constraints simultaneously; the positive sum of vertices witnesses strict feasibility iff each strict constraint is positive at some vertex. Every complementary branch is exhausted; empty complement proves a legal upper witness exists at every actual leaf point, including tie faces. Combined with 71 fixed-witness leaves and all 141255 full-direction lower/near checks from prior report proves upper depth<=7 for entire positive cone.
